JOB DESCRIPTION: The main focus of this project is organizing and delivering practical first aid courses. Volunteers will help prepare and conduct sessions where participants learn CPR, how to use a defibrillator (AED), and how to respond to choking emergencies. They will also help organize the workshops, assess participants' knowledge, and collect feedback to measure the project's impact.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Volunteers will work with a different group of beneficiaries each week: children with disabilities, adults with disabilities, toddlers, and elderly people. They will organize activities such as finger painting, clay modeling, making bracelets and decorations, sensory games with sand and water, music and karaoke sessions, dancing, role-playing, and simple theatre activities. They will also help with outdoor activities, nature trips, and cultural visits for seniors, adapting the activities to each group's needs alongside the foundation's staff.
EXTRA INFO: - Accommodation                -1 meal per day  (not vegan, may contain pork)
REQUIREMENTS: They should be willing to work with all categories of people, be empathetic, and take initiative by coming up with ideas for activities.                               Volunteers will work directly with beneficiaries at Alpha Transilvană’s day care centers, including children and teenagers with special needs (ages 3–18) and elderly people. They will organize and facilitate creative, hands-on activities such as clay modeling, cooking workshops, and other interactive activities adapted to the beneficiaries’ needs and abilities.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Volunteers will work alongside coaches at a sports club, assisting with children's training sessions, physical preparation, and sports competitions. They will help plan and organize training activities, participate in practice sessions, and support the preparation of matches and other competitions throughout the four weeks.
REQUIREMENTS: Enabler wants to join the interview

JOB DESCRIPTION: Volunteers will work with beneficiaries with disabilities, organizing creative workshops involving painting, drawing, sculpting, and other arts and crafts activities. They will plan and lead interactive sessions, artistic games, and creative challenges, helping beneficiaries experiment with different materials and work on individual and group art projects. They will also organize cultural activities and outdoor visits, support beneficiaries in developing their artistic skills, and prepare a final art exhibition to showcase their work.
REQUIREMENTS: Volunteers should be comfortable working with people with disabilities, willing to share their own culture, and preferably have some experience with arts and crafts.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Volunteers will work in international teams across different schools and kindergartens in the city, organizing educational activities for children, including arts and crafts, interactive games, hands-on workshops, and outdoor activities. The project is organized in collaboration with the City Hall and aims to reach around 4,000 children, especially those with limited access to such opportunities. Throughout the 4 weeks, volunteers will follow a specially designed curriculum and also organize a Global Village in the city center, where they will share their cultures with the local community.

Global Volunteers will be responsible for delivering immersive and artistic activities that inspire the flourishing of imagination, problem solving, critical thinking, creativity, teamwork and communication skills, which can be used across a range of occupational fields.
